description: This file defines data models, enums, and configurations for setting up guardrails in the litellm proxy system, including support for various guardrail types, configurations, and related classes.

classes.name: SupportedGuardrailIntegrations
classes.description: Enumeration of supported guardrail integration types.

classes.name: Role
